verdict.rationale: The evidence describes an API for managing contacts, events, transactional email, campaigns, content, themes, and workflows. No documented endpoint exports campaign or workflow performance metrics such as opens, clicks, or conversions. The revenue-attribution claim on the homepage describes in-product insight, not API access, so it does not count toward pulling metrics into a warehouse or dashboard.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull campaign and flow performance metrics through the API into my own warehouse or dashboards
